findings.title: Ad hoc filters and variables are now applied twice on split queries
findings.body: `runSplitQuery` now calls `datasource.applyTemplateVariables(query, scopedVars, filters)` and then hands the result to `datasource.runQuery(subRequest)` (querySplitting.ts:180). `runQuery` calls `super.query`, and `DataSourceWithBackend.query` calls `this.applyTemplateVariables(q, request.scopedVars, request.filters)` again for every target (packages/grafana-runtime/src/utils/DataSourceWithBackend.ts:185). The sub-request is `{...request, targets}`, so it still carries `request.filters`. `applyTemplateVariables` calls `addAdHocFilters` (datasource.ts:1127), which adds each filter to the selector with `addLabelToQuery`. The second pass can therefore add every ad hoc filter to the expression again. I did not read `addLabelToQuery` to confirm whether it dedupes. The same applies to `runShardSplitQuery` (shardQuerySplitting.ts:52). Before this PR the split path interpolated once, inside `runQuery`. The new tests mock `runQuery`, so they cannot see the second pass. Fix: either strip `filters` from the sub-requests after the first pass, or interpolate only the fields needed for splitting (`step`, `expr`) and leave the full transform to `runQuery`. Also add a test with `request.filters` set that runs through the real `runQuery`/`query`.

contracts.action: Interpolate targets with applyTemplateVariables before splitting (time-split and shard-split paths)
contracts.equivalent_path: DataSourceWithBackend.query applies applyTemplateVariables per target (DataSourceWithBackend.ts:185) and is reached via datasource.runQuery for each split sub-request
contracts.before_after: Before: split path passed raw targets to runQuery, which interpolated once. After: the targets are interpolated in runSplitQuery and again in runQuery, because the sub-request still carries the same scopedVars and filters.
contracts.visible_effect: Step and expression are resolved before splitting, so step grouping uses the interpolated value. Ad hoc filters may be added twice in the final expression.
contracts.failure_mode: Not applicable (synchronous map). Risk is double application, not a rejection.
contracts.open_question: Does addLabelToQuery dedupe an identical label matcher that is already present?

summary: The PR interpolates targets in `runSplitQuery` and `runShardSplitQuery` before they reach `runQuery`. `runQuery` goes through `DataSourceWithBackend.query`, which interpolates again with the same `request.filters`, so ad hoc filters can be applied twice. The new tests mock `runQuery`, so they would not catch it. I rated the finding medium confidence because I did not read `addLabelToQuery` to see whether it dedupes. I did not look into why the shard test expects `applyTemplateVariables` to be called 5 times.
